localVerification.fullLocalVfsRuntime: Not run in the storage-constrained 32 GB cloud VFS snapshot; real integration completed on clean Linux CI. No named data volumes or user work deleted.

capacityAcceptance.scope: Observed socket peaks belong to the separate socket-only capacity job; they are not decoded viewers or proof of three-video performance at that scale. Use the actual numeric field above.
capacityAcceptance.configurationConstraint: Default RESILIENCE_WORKER_CONNECTIONS=512 in a single API gateway; proxied sockets consume client/upstream connections. The bounded trial is consistent with this constraint, not a full root-cause or sustainable-capacity guarantee.

measurementDefinitions.concurrency: HTTP/HLS active means actual fetches in flight; socket/chat means connected synthetic clients; browser means active decoded Chromium viewers. Target and allocation are separate.

histograms.percentiles: Merged observation bucket upper bounds; null when no observations. Worker metrics retained below.

measurementDefinitions.http: Completed workload HTTP requests and response bytes; intentional shutdown aborts excluded. Browser/socket handshake HTTP traffic is not instrumented by this raw-fetch counter.
measurementDefinitions.chat: Synthetic sends are visibly labelled and ephemeral; confirmed delivery requires another same-room client. Actual guest messages persist in PostgreSQL and are independently counted by server metrics.
measurementDefinitions.faults: Original observer/Healer clocks plus separate functional verification. Network case is timed cleanup and safe-read/circuit reconnection; no container repair is attributed to cleanup.
measurementDefinitions.playback: Three independent browser players sampled every 250 ms during each fault. A counted interruption uses a >=2000 ms consecutive decoded-progress gap. Server playbackInterruptionMs remains null.
measurementDefinitions.audit: All actual generator final reports were confirmed and counters matched server history. Protocol-only validation vectors were removed by their newly-created test UUID, leaving actual workload history intact.

notes: Visually reviewed all 17 actual CI captures. Public home presents exactly three channels without public account controls.
Presentation shows all three genuine decoded streams playing; mobile stacks players, desktop aligns all three.
Capacity dashboard labels the 50K target unverified and distinguishes requested allocation, actual activity and historical results.
Watch captures show genuine video and connected guest chat; synthetic messages are explicitly labelled.
No document-level horizontal overflow in automated checks; mobile resource labels may wrap within cards.

limitations: 50,000 simulated clients and 50,000 decoded viewers are unverified; no distributed generators were provisioned.
The isolated socket stage does not establish combined three-stream capacity at its observed peak.
Redis interruption caused actual HTTP errors and the unchanged generator error budget stopped that stage; independent healing and final audit still completed.
Single-host gateways/relay/database/Redis/host and connection/bandwidth limits remain.
Windows/OBS/LAN commands follow implemented scripts; no Windows VM or three physical laptops were available.
Trusted Docker adapters retain host-equivalent authority; production deployment and internet ingress need separate engineering.
